terms.title: Keywords
terms.description: Search terms, one per line ("artificial intelligence", "tariff"). Each term is searched separately. Leave empty to get everything matching the other filters.

agencies.title: Agencies
agencies.description: Limit to specific agencies, one per line. Accepts common abbreviations ("EPA", "FDA", "SEC"), full names ("Environmental Protection Agency") or Federal Register slugs. Applied to every keyword. Leave empty for all agencies.

docTypes.title: Document types
docTypes.description: Which document types to include. Leave empty for all four.

sinceDays.title: Published within (days)
sinceDays.description: Only documents published in the last N days.

significantOnly.title: Significant documents only
significantOnly.description: Only documents deemed significant under Executive Order 12866 (major economic or policy impact).

newOnly.title: Monitor mode: new documents only
newOnly.description: Remember every document this actor has already returned and emit only ones it has not seen before. Run on a schedule for a clean feed of new rules and notices - quiet runs cost nothing.

maxPerQuery.title: Documents per keyword
maxPerQuery.description: How many documents to return per keyword (newest first).

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows in total.
